sourceIntent.verbatim: Turn my grant assessment process into something junior staff and AI can run, while I retain final sign-off on awards.

routing.rationale: The user wants to turn professional know-how into a repeatable flow with explicit human decision authority.

interpretation.job: Capture and productise a professional assessment method.
interpretation.subject: Grant assessment and award recommendation process.
interpretation.outcome: Define a repeatable grant-assessment flow that junior staff and authorised agents can operate, with evidence and quality gates that preserve the expert’s final award decision.
interpretation.value: Scale delivery while preserving professional quality, proprietary method, and final decision authority.

overview.summary: The expert method is being captured as a controlled, repeatable assessment flow.

nextStep.summary: Walk through one representative grant assessment from intake to final sign-off.

intent.text: Turn my grant assessment process into something junior staff and AI can run, while I retain final sign-off on awards.

statement.text: Define a repeatable grant-assessment flow that junior staff and authorised agents can operate, with evidence and quality gates that preserve the expert’s final award decision.

successCriteria.description: One representative assessment is captured end to end with decisions, evidence, and exceptions.
Quality and escalation gates are explicit and testable.
Final award decisions remain with the expert or another explicitly authorised human.

included.text: Capture inputs, assessment steps, evidence, quality gates, exceptions, outputs, and sign-off.

excluded.text: Automated award issuance, payment, or client deployment is outside this composition.

constraints.text: The expert retains final sign-off on awards.

statement.text: The method has enough repeatability to be expressed as a controlled flow.

assumptions.validationMethod: Test the proposed flow against representative and exceptional cases.

statement.text: Which representative assessment best exposes the real method and judgment calls?

milestones.title: Test against normal and exceptional cases

completion.definition: A tested Flow proposal reproduces the method’s routine work, escalates exceptions, and preserves final human award authority.

publication.reason: The Topic may contain proprietary methodology and client information, so the contract body must be encrypted and referenced rather than stored inline.

blocks.content: Define a repeatable grant-assessment flow that junior staff and authorised agents can operate, with evidence and quality gates that preserve the expert’s final award decision.
Start with one real assessment that includes routine steps and at least one judgment call.
Final award sign-off remains with the expert. Agent output is advisory.

content: Select and walk through one representative grant assessment.

humanRoles.purpose: Explain the method, approve abstractions, and retain final award authority.
Test whether the flow preserves quality and escalates exceptions.

agentRoles.purpose: Extract candidate steps, inputs, evidence, and exceptions from a representative case without claiming authority.
agentRoles.output: An editable process map with provenance and unresolved judgment points.
agentRoles.activationCondition: A representative case has been supplied in the protected Topic.
agentRoles.stopWhen: The representative case is mapped and every unresolved judgment point is identified.

firstTurn.message:
I’ve framed this as turning your grant-assessment method into a controlled Flow while keeping final award authority with you.

I’ve started with a representative-case walkthrough, an editable process map, and an explicit sign-off boundary.

Which real assessment should we use to expose the method and its judgment calls?

quickActions.action: Select a representative assessment and begin the walkthrough.

quickActions.action: Describe the current method before abstracting it.

quickActions.label: Define decision authority
quickActions.action: Make final sign-off and escalation authority explicit.
